title: Stochastic Wright's Equation: Existence of Invariant Measures
summary: Wright's delay differential equation is one of the prime examples of a fully nonlinear equation without an explicit solution and whose dynamics can be understood by analytic means. In this paper, we introduce stochastic perturbations by adding Brownian noise with a bounded Lipschitz noise coefficient to a transformed version of Wright's equation. The transformation considered plays an important role in the deterministic theory as well.
